## What it is

The other diameter. Two clips, one quarter-turn higher than the low cross, and the upper half of the lap. Same print pose as the low cross.

## Design notes

- Turned 90° from the low cross when assembled, so the four clips of a level are 90° apart and 5.75 mm apart in height.
- Same diamond as the low cross, point up in this piece's own print pose. Turned 90° on the pin, that is still a point-up diamond, because the diagonals are equal.
- A tooth at the top of the hub, toward this piece's lower clip, stops the cross being turned 180°. The lap still sets it at 90° to the low cross.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't stretch the diamond. A longer point on one axis is a flat ceiling once this piece is turned 90° from the low piece.
